set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM model/fit and dataset/workflow adapters; generic factor/operator kernels belong in Gale. Consumer: PLS Neuro; user explicitly adopted upstream ownership. Reference contract will be linked from /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/docs/first-level-estimation-contract.md. This issue is native implementation, not merely API planning.

Problem reproduced by current source: OlsPrepared.fit in modules/fit/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/fmri/fit/Ols.scala always computes all coefficients, residual variance and standard errors; Ols.prepare always forms crossproduct and normalized covariance. Consumers requesting task betas or a few contrasts pay for unwanted nuisance maps and inferential products.

Scope and acceptance:
- Provide a small composable public request/preparation/execution API using structural coefficient selection and named linear functionals with units and FIR-time identity. Existing full-fit APIs remain lawful. Model/noise/run-pooling semantics are separate from requested result products and execution policy.
- Compile output requests into explicit internal computational dependencies. Estimates-only OLS skips variance, covariance, standard-error, fitted/residual and nuisance-map materialization when none is required. Do not use absent/zero/NaN inferential placeholders; distinguish not requested, unavailable, failed and present products with typed evidence. Required internal variance/whitening evidence can be computed without saving all maps.
- Implement stable design-only preparation and a compiled selected-estimate operator for shared-design OLS. With D P = Q R and desired L, solve R^T U = (L P)^T and apply A^T Y with A=Q U, reusing Gale factors/reflectors and blocked kernels. Avoid inverse/normal-equation defaults, full pseudoinverses, full time projectors and response-sized nuisance residualization. General Gale API gaps require native Gale issues/fixes.
- Bind/cache by exact realized design, retained scans, preprocessing order, scaling, requested functionals and rank policy. Reject nonestimable requests under the admitted policy; preserve original column order and physical FIR/run/voxel identity. Missing scans or voxelwise design/weights must not share an incompatible operator.
- Route ordinary bounded dataset/fit-plan calls through the supported estimate executor; no full spatial-domain read or final full-fit construction defeats selection. Keep fit preparation inspectable and execution-topology evidence compatible with existing out-of-core work bd-01KX6G9B1ZT10A3214DPA096RZ without making its entire distributed program a prerequisite.
- For unsupported optimized noise/pooling combinations, provide an explicit truthful fallback preserving existing science or reject with a typed capability error. No silent substitution of OLS for GLS, averaging for inverse-covariance fixed effects, or minimum-norm coefficients for identifiable betas. Existing GLS scope issue bd-01M1Z2050HGVC8FAZM07TM2K9Q remains its proper owner.
- Independent SVD/QR or R references cover nuisance correlation, reordered/scaled columns, selected betas, contrasts and FIR, rank/near-rank defects, noiseless recovery, exact fixed temporal transforms, scan gaps, block/layout invariance and output retention. Prove skipped work through public-path allocation/execution evidence, not only equal output values. Shared JVM+Scala.js suites and affected direct-consumer checks must pass. Publish examples that compile; benchmark/adoption claims remain separate.

Exploratory arithmetic check from consumer planning: /private/tmp/plsneuro-estimate-operator-check.json has independent SVD agreement up to 1.29e-14 on small OLS, nuisance, retained-scan and fixed-whitening cases. This is neither provider implementation evidence nor a benchmark; regenerate durable fixtures under native tests.
set.title: Compile requested first-level estimates with a typed output-selective API
